notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the standard federation MOM FOM-module and MIM content-report surfaces. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and logical-time implementation. It verifies standard MOM handle lookup, reliable report subscription, FOM-module and MIM request/report payload decoding, callback-time subscription revalidation for HLA_EVOKED, immediate callback delivery for HLA_IMMEDIATE, and the public InteractionParameterNotDefined behavior for a malformed MIM request. It deliberately avoids provider-specific names, registries, headers, source fixtures, and exception behavior not required by the standard.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador federation MOM FOM-module and MIM request/report lookup, subscription, and send services with FederateAmbassador interaction callbacks
